name: gui-starter
description: Run the workflow editor and API together. See README.md.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && poetry install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,types -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:types"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
